content: Dewit adi Bepaŋdi tubulodawek yoŋa ninadi tuguk
Yahwe, nai deniŋ kotigoŋ nadinambaaŋ? Be agaŋ binabudapmaŋ hinek-kube tilaŋ? Be nai dedigoŋ hinek sigilulum tinambaaŋ?
Nai deniŋ hinek folofigitane dapmawaak? Be helebufa dedigoŋ hinek welemulap nadiwaat? Be nai dedigoŋ hinek binabune memikneyedi nehitifoneeŋ?
O Yahwe, Bepaŋne, nutok nadinamuŋa yonadine nadiweŋ. Tiŋa kotigoŋ nehitubu-kilitiune kumuŋ mu tibit.
Unduŋ tubune memikneyedi indiŋ tuwot mu yoneŋ, “Agaŋ yalitifooŋ kalakapmemun.” Du mu binabeŋ, toboniŋ nehitubu-lodaune memikneyedi naniŋgege tiŋa nadifo tuwot mu tineŋ.
Du welegedi hinek nabukahilelaŋ u helemahelemaŋ unduŋ hinek nadisukilitilat. Tiŋa du kotigoŋ nanagilaaŋ doktiŋa nu nadifo tilat.
Yahwe negoŋ momooŋ hinek tinamguk doktiŋa nu kap toŋa nadifooŋ wou nintiloit.
